description: Call this once per task when you start a customer task on a site (a return or exchange, a refund, a cancellation, a warranty claim, an account recovery, a document submission), before you open its help pages, even when nothing is blocked. Look up recorded task routes for a public hostname: for a kind of customer task (a refund, a cancellation, a booking and so on), an obstacle and the routes the site's own documents name. A record may carry condition_text, a condition the site's page states, quoted as written: it is not our judgement, so decide yourself whether it applies to your task, with the page at source_url. The answer is a list of records, not a guarantee and not advice; an empty list does not mean there is no route. Sends only the hostname and an optional task kind, and changes nothing. Read summary_line first. field_notes explains outcome, period and routes_tried.

site_host.description: The public hostname of the site whose task routes you want, lowercase, for example example.com. Only the host: no scheme, URL path, query, port or credentials.
site_host.title: Site Host

task_kind.description: Optional: one kind of customer task to look up, from the list. Leave it out to get the records for every task kind of the site.
task_kind.title: Task Kind

name: find_task_route

RouteKind.description:
A kind of channel the site or its regulator offers. A route that would describe the person's own situation (hiring
counsel, for one) is deliberately not a value; adding one is a one-line change here plus scripts/README.md.
RouteKind.title: RouteKind

SiteRequires.description: What the site asks for that only the person can supply. Named for the site's requirement, never the person's situation.
SiteRequires.title: SiteRequires

TaskRoute.description: One task-route record as an answer carries it. ``sensitive`` and ``period`` are set by the server.

condition_text.description: A condition or caveat quoted as the site's own page words it (at most 200 characters). Not our judgement and not classified: whether it applies to your task is for you to decide, with the page at source_url. It may state a condition other than the obstacle.
condition_text.title: Condition Text

outcome.description: How the case ended. not_applicable marks a record taken from a document: it names a route or a condition and nobody's result is recorded. It does not mean the task does not apply.

period.description: The quarter in which the record was read, reported or recorded. It is not a deadline and not a validity window.
period.title: Period

routes_tried.description: The routes tried (a reported case) or, on a document record, the channels this record copied from the document, which may not be every channel the document names. An empty list means this record lists none, not that the document or the site has none.
routes_tried.title: Routes Tried

TaskRoute.title: TaskRoute

field_notes.description: Fixed sentences on what outcome, period and routes_tried mean in these records. Left out when there is no record.
field_notes.title: Field Notes
